newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore HSFO steady to firm in line with swaps.
newsitem.headline: Singapore HSFO steady to firm in line with swaps.

text.p: High sulphur fuel oil prices on Monday were assessed steady to firm on resumed Chinese demand and strong paper quotes, traders said.
High sulphur, 180 centistoke fuel oil was quoted at $121/$123 per tonne on Friday.
Traders said the market remained supported with demand still seen from China.
They said firm swaps levels have also helped support sentiment.
December swaps were indicated at $119.25/$120.50 against Friday's quotes at $119/$120 per tonne.

Traders said high freight costs have also capped the already limited exports from Mideast in December. Mideast exports were expected to be less than normal in December due to the maintenance turnarounds at three refineries there.
